title: Play cluster passages without AudioWorklet support
description:
As a curator, I want to audition a cluster passage in browsers without AudioWorklet support so that reviewing a draft is still possible.

Feature: direct passage audition

Scenario: Browser without AudioWorklet
  Given a browser where AudioContext.audioWorklet is unavailable
  When I select Play the passage on a cluster representative
  Then the decoded sample passage plays through a supported AudioContext route
  And the score-rendering engine is not required
  And a failure is presented as a playback failure rather than an addModule exception

Exclusions: this does not change score playback or the worklet renderer.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Reproduced the failure boundary from the browser error: sample/clip passage playback calls the score engine initializer, which assumes AudioContext.audioWorklet.addModule exists. I will bypass that renderer for decoded passage audition and verify the actual Play control in the browser.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Verification complete: built the web client and ran `npm run test:semantic` (146 passing). I opened a fresh LAN browser page for draft a66b94482498f1db3d411e6822c048caa6a98662bb0c51117b97749f9faffca1, waited for the representative cards, clicked Play the passage, and observed the active control change to “Stop the passage.” Browser console contained no errors, including no addModule/AudioWorklet failure. The local listener remains bound to 0.0.0.0:5181 and serves the required Wasm asset with HTTP 200.

right_now_summary: Cluster passage playback now works in browsers without AudioWorklet support.
